name: Econophysics

subjectOf.text: Against critics who call quantum econophysics purely phenomenological, the author holds that quantum economics still offers a genuinely novel perspective that challenges the assumptions of classical economics.
subjectOf.abstract: Despite these criticisms, quantum economics offers a novel perspective on economic systems and challenges the assumptions of classical economics.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878

subjectOf.text: Existing quantum economic models carry unresolved defects that the field must address: some lack a realistic connection with financial markets, and others strip out the features that make the formalism quantum in the first place.
subjectOf.abstract: Another challenge is to address the criticisms and limitations of existing quantum models and approaches, such as the lack of a realistic connection with financial markets or the removal of quantum-specific features in some models.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and the Future of Work (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900880
